digest.component_or_area: IAM policy — review-bot container Bedrock authorization
propositions: review-bot container needs IAM permission to invoke Bedrock's Converse API with short-lived credentials from the existing instance role, not static API keys

bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream are the actions checked by Bedrock's Converse API, not bedrock:Converse or bedrock:ConverseStream, verified by real calls from the instance
cross-region inference profiles require wildcard regions in both the foundation-model and inference-profile resource ARNs, and the profile-prefix must also be wildcarded to permit global.* profiles

IMDS is reachable from the review-bot container by default; only if AC1's IMDSv2 token PUT fails should http_put_response_hop_limit be raised to 2, accompanied by bounded-exposure documentation in ADR 0046

policy simulator answers what the policy permits for the named action, not which action the service checks; real credentialed calls from the scoped role are the only proof that an authorization contract works
